name: Fliparr
description: Fliparr is Tinder-style swiping for your Radarr and Seerr queue — movies and TV. Instead of a wall of checkboxes, each title fills your phone screen (poster, IMDb/Rotten Tomatoes/Metacritic/TMDb ratings, genres, synopsis, trailer) and you decide with a swipe. Movies come from Radarr's recommendations, Seerr's endless discover feed, or both blended together; TV comes from Seerr (Overseerr/Jellyseerr), since Sonarr has no recommendation feed to swipe. A Movies/TV/Both toggle picks what's showing, and coloured per-type badges tell movie and TV cards apart at a glance. Swipe right to add (Radarr) or request (Seerr), left to exclude or skip — every card carries its own origin, so a blended deck routes each swipe to the right backend on its own. Undo reverses the last one, up to 50 deep. Filter by genre and minimum rating. Connect Radarr and/or Seerr in the app's Settings screen, each with a Test button; API keys stay server-side and are never sent to the browser. LAN-only, no login, no cloud. Needs at least one of Radarr (v3) or Seerr — movies work with either or both, TV requires Seerr. Point service URLs at host.docker.internal if they run on this Unraid server (this template adds the host-gateway mapping) rather than the host LAN IP, which can break on a container recreate.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Stores the Radarr/Seerr connections, settings, skip list, and undo history. Mount it or these reset on recreate.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the Fliparr web UI. Clear of Radarr (7878), Sonarr (8989), Prowlarr (9696).

variables.name: Radarr URL
variables.description: Radarr's address (optional). Keep host.docker.internal if Radarr runs on this Unraid server; otherwise use its LAN IP. Seeds a fresh install — once you save a connection in the app, that one wins.

variables.name: Radarr API Key
variables.description: Radarr → Settings → General → API Key. Treat it like a password. Seeds a fresh install; can also be set in the app's Settings screen.

variables.name: Seerr URL
variables.description: Overseerr/Jellyseerr address (optional). Required for TV and optional for movies; leave blank for a Radarr-only setup. Seeds a fresh install — the app's saved connection wins once set.

variables.name: Seerr API Key
variables.description: Seerr → Settings → General → API Key. Treat it like a password. Seeds a fresh install; can also be set in the app's Settings screen.
